question_or_symptom: A malformed or truncated SCM_RIGHTS message can install visible file descriptors before the receiver decides that the control record is invalid.
observation: MSG_CTRUNC, duplicate descriptors, wrong message types, and unexpected ancillary data are rejection conditions, but every descriptor already delivered by recvmsg is process-owned and leaks unless closed explicitly.
conclusion: Ancillary parsing must acquire resource ownership before it evaluates protocol validity.
decision: Provide bounded control storage, request MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC, immediately move every visible SCM_RIGHTS descriptor into RAII ownership, then validate truncation, level, type, count, and operation cardinality; close all descriptors on every rejection, disconnect, or carrier failure path.
invalidated_assumptions: A rejected recvmsg cannot leak descriptors because the payload was not accepted.
MSG_CTRUNC means no usable descriptors were installed.
